sourceEvidence.statement: Frozen Ubuntu workflow sets up pnpm from packageManager and installs at the repository root, but does not select Node.
Target app manifest contributes postinstall Nuxt preparation but no independent runtime or package-manager pin.
Root manifest pins pnpm 10.25.0 and routes build and development commands to the apps/v4 workspace.
Frozen root workspace lock is bound for deterministic pnpm install --frozen-lockfile preparation.
